apiVersion.description: API version of the referenced resource (e.g., 'planspec.io/v1alpha1'). Optional; defaults to current API version.

kind.description: Kind of the referenced resource (e.g., 'Capability', 'Gate'). Optional; inferred from context when unambiguous.

name.description: Name of the referenced resource (DNS label format)

namespace.description: Namespace of the referenced resource. Defaults to the referring object's namespace.

uid.description: UID of the referenced resource for strong references. When provided, validates that the resolved resource matches this UID.
